title: Pinzón from Cape Santo Agostinho to the Amazon, 1500
summary: Pinzón sailed from Spain in 1499 and, by the usual account, sighted the coast of Brazil at Cape Santo Agostinho early in 1500, some months before Cabral. He followed the coast north and west and entered the mouth of the Amazon. He is credited with the first European landfall in Brazil, though Cabral's, which is better recorded, took Brazil for Portugal.
